SD43-X02.name: The MoonlightDragon Strike-Siegwurm X
SD43-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit is exhausted, refresh this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Return an opposing Spirit with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the deckbottom. Also, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, while you control any White Grandwalker Nexus, this attacking Spirit can't be blocked.

SD43-003.name: The ReticleSoldier Muses
SD43-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For every three cards on the opposing Hand, put one core from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Except via Burst effects, neither player can summon Spirit cards without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Red/Green]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Green Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

SD43-CP01.name: Bashin Dan
SD43-CP01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Astral Dragon/Astral Soul/Astral Deity/Galaxian/Worldswalker & Cost 3 or more) (Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grnadwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV1][LV2] Flash -
(Send two core from this Nexus to the Void) Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. Or, destroy an opposing Nexus.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
At the end of your Brave Spirit's battle, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

SD43-009.name: Bladraw
SD43-009.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, deploy one exactly-named "Bashin Dan"/"The Moonlight Barone", without paying the cost. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

SD43-002.name: Dorado-Dragon
SD43-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
By destroying an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, draw one card.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as White.

SD43-001.name: Igua-Dragon
SD43-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

[During Brave] [LV1][LV2]
All your "Astral Soul"/ "Astral Deity"/ "Galaxian" family Spirits get +5000 BP.

SD43-010.name: Rising Flame
SD43-010.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
You can summon an "Astral Dragon" family Spirit card that was depleted/destroyed when this Burst activated from your Trash by paying one cost. Then by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 8000 BP. Effects of the Spirits destroyed by this effect don't activate.

SD43-004.name: Slider Bear
SD43-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Red.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Heavy Armor: Red/Purple/Blue]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple/Blue Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.

SD43-006.name: The KingSnake Pend-Viper
SD43-006.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing exhausted Spirit.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to their Reserve. When this effect depletes a Spirit, draw a card.

SD43-CP02.name: The Moonlight Barone
SD43-CP02.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Armed Machine/Astral Soul/Astral Deity/Galaxian/Worldswalker & Cost 3 or more) (Brave)]
◆When you summon/advent a target Spirit/Brave, you can put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grnadwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put one core from the Void onto this Nexus.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send two core from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh an "Armed Machine"/"Astral Soul"/"Astral Deity"/"Galaxian" family Spirit you control.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Armed Machine"/"Astral Soul"/"Astral Deity"/"Galaxian" family Spirit is blocked, refresh that Spirit.

SD43-X01.name: The SunDragon Sieg-Apollodragon X
SD43-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing refreshed Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, destroy an opposing blocking target.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 9000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Also, if you control any Red Grandwalker Nexus, send an opposing life to the Reserve.

SD43-008.name: The TwinFangEmperor Orth-Lord
SD43-008.effect:
[During Brave] (When Attacks)
You can discard three cards from your Hand. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes.

SD43-007.name: The WhiteGun Phoenix-Blaster
SD43-007.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Return two opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Hand. Or, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[During Brave] [Heavy Armor: Purple/White]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Purple/White Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.
